observations.content: Assistant researched MiniMax-M3 thinking leak root cause: on OpenAI-compatible API thinking is embedded in content inside  thinking tags by default, fix is reasoning_split:true which moves thinking to reasoning_details/reasoning_content.

Assistant determined MiniMax Anthropic endpoint api.minimax.io/anthropic/v1/messages returns thinking as separate content blocks (type thinking), making leak structurally impossible, but noted pi bugs: pi#8839 anthropic-messages provider schema error with MiniMax, /anthropic endpoint reports 200K context instead of 1M, and interleaved thinking stops after first tool call.
Assistant identified pi issue #7155 from earendil-works/pi: MiniMax-M3 thinking content leaks into assistant text response, still present in 0.82.1; noted whether fixed in pi 0.84.3 is unknown.
Assistant noted MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-M3#28: model sometimes emits answer tokens BEFORE closing  response tag, so even correct parsing truncates answers (model-side quirk).

Assistant drafted an English GitHub comment for issue getpaseo/paseo#3845 describing an independent reproduction: Paseo 0.6.1, Pi 0.84.3, Linux, Node v24, extension doing automatic context compaction then resuming via pi.sendMessage(message,{triggerTurn:true}); reproduced 3 times in ~20 min; attentionReason finished while lastStatus running; new user message does not start a turn until manual ESC stop.
Assistant recommended for scout role switching model to glm-5.3-flash as simplest fix (no leak, has vision, cheap) rather than MiniMax Anthropic endpoint or reasoning_split.
User approved the GitHub comment and said to send it, and asked the assistant to provide guidance for testing reasoning_split:true pass-through on the gateway.
gh auth confirmed logged in to github.com as account SilverKnightKMA with token gho_*** protocol https.

Found provider config in /home/coder/.pi/agent/models.json: model id mmcp/MiniMax-M3, name [MiniMax-M3][MMCP][T][V][L], compat thinkingFormat openai and supportsReasoningEffort true, contextWindow 1048576, maxTokens 65536, cost input 0.3 output 1.2.
Posted GitHub comment to issue 3845 on getpaseo/paseo successfully, URL https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/issues/3845#issuecomment-5469284622.
MiniMax gateway is local proxy http://cli-proxy-api:8317/v1 with apiKey stored in models.json under providers/cli-openai.

A/B test on gateway: control call content contained  thinking... response inline (the leak reproduced at API level, no reasoning field); with reasoning_split:true content was clean and thinking went to both reasoning_content string and structured reasoning_details array.
Assessed pi's model compat thinkingFormat openai means pi parses reasoning_content into its thinking channel, so only the reasoning_split flag is missing to fix MiniMax leak.
pi docs scan found no extraBody/extra_body/defaultBody/requestBody option, so pi has no support for injecting per-model extra body params.

Streaming test with reasoning_split:true confirmed: 33 reasoning chunks arrive via delta.reasoning_content and 13 clean content chunks via delta.content, no  thinking anywhere; raw SSE shape is choices[0].delta with role/reasoning_content/reasoning_details, model MiniMax-M3.

Verdict reached: gateway cli-proxy-api passes reasoning_split:true through to MiniMax in both non-stream and stream modes; pi already parses delta.reasoning_content; the flag must be injected at gateway level since pi cannot.

Web search found CLIProxyAPI supports injecting/overriding request body params per model via a payload block in config.yaml using default (set only if missing), default-raw, override (force value), and override-raw keys with gjson/sjson JSON-path targeting filtered by model name wildcard and protocol (openai, gemini, claude, codex).
CLIProxyAPI example config shown: payload.override with models name gpt-* protocol codex setting reasoning.effort high, and default-raw for gemini-2.5-pro generationConfig.responseJsonSchema.
